title: Migration/schema drift and shared database state break 42 integration tests
notes:
Cluster A from the final integration run: 42 failures across ext02_webhook_dispatch_test (10), ADP/OIDC migration checks (8), env03 (5), EXP-201/202 entities (3), service catalog (6), env01/env02 (2), and 8 other cases. Observed missing webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref, missing public.tenant_realm_binding, missing tenant entity_type_instances, tenant_storage_mode_check and webhook_deliveries_status_check mismatches. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 13213-16646, 23258-38773, 38985-42352.

[OCCURRENCE 2026-08-04T02:43:24Z] run_id=WF03-gh375-20260804 handoff_id=4a1c3d5e-7b9f-4e2a-8c6d-0f1e2a3b4c5d trigger=user_request — Recurrence of missing webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref column in per-tenant schemas. Root cause: migrations GBL-128_exp501_secrets.sql and GBL-133_iss0112_schema_ledger_reconcile.sql only attempt to add secret_ref to public.webhook_subscriptions, but that table was dropped from public by GBL-073. Neither migration adds the column to SCHEMA-mode tenant schemas, leaving those schemas incomplete. Integration tests that access webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref in tenant context fail with missing-column errors.

root_cause.details: Category F (environment/configuration), with database-contract symptoms: the shared db_test baseline violates INV-TI-1 and INV-TI-2. The live public.schema_migrations ledger reports 1 row while migrations/ contains 97 SQL files, yet the prior zig build migrate log reports all listed migrations as skipped. The schema probe has only public and tenant_default schemas and 51 public tables, while tenant_rows.txt contains 10 tenants (1 SCHEMA and 9 LEGACY_RLS). Bare public.tenant fixtures, including ensureDefaultOidcSeeds' default tenant, omit tenant_type='test'; tools/clean_test_db.py filters cleanup by tenant_type and therefore leaves production-defaulted fixtures. The resulting contaminated baseline explains the integration clusters: EXT-02/webhook failures at _integration_final.log lines 13213-16646; tenant-schema/search_path failures and missing events at 6384-6484 and 38774-38845; ISS-503 pre-flight cutoff at 8713-8717; ADP/OIDC migration-contract failures at 23258-35661; and service/entity/env missing-column plus fixture failures at 38865-42354. This matches docs/guides/test_infrastructure_guide.md §3 (Infrastructure Health Checklist), §4 (Green-Main Gate), and §10's long-lived database and tenant fixture anti-patterns.

candidate_resolution: Reconcile the canonical migration ledger with actual public and tenant-schema objects, make corrective migrations idempotent, and provision each integration target from a deterministic schema baseline before validating the affected contracts.
resolution:
PARTIAL / REOPENED (2026-08-08, during ISS-0184/GH-517 diagnosis): the 2026-08-04 fix (migration 1134_iss0112_add_secret_ref_to_tenant_schemas.sql) is structurally incomplete. It is a `-- scope: public`-tagged one-time DO-block that iterates tenants existing AT MIGRATION-APPLY TIME and ALTERs each one found -- it is not part of the per-tenant DDL that provisionTenantSchema()->runForSchema() applies to a tenant schema created AFTER migration 1134 has already run once. Every test-created tenant is created after suite-startup migration, so it never receives secret_ref/secret_key_id. Reproduced directly on 2026-08-08 against workspace r-co-2: ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig TC-EXT-02-INT-01 fails 'expected 201, found 500' with the postgres server log showing 'column "secret_ref" of relation "webhook_subscriptions" does not exist'. GH #375 reopened with reproduction steps. Correct fix: move the ADD COLUMN DDL into a proper per-tenant-scoped migration file (no GBL- prefix, no `-- scope: public` header) so runForSchema() applies it the normal way to every tenant schema, existing and future. See docs/issue-reports/ISS-0184-diagnosis.yaml cluster C2. NOTE: the original 2026-08-04 resolution text below is retained for history but its 'no missing secret_ref column errors' verification claim did not hold for dynamically-provisioned tenants (likely because the 2026-08-04 verification run's tenants pre-dated migration 1134's own application, which trivially satisfied the DO-block's iteration).

---ORIGINAL RESOLUTION TEXT (2026-08-04, now superseded)---
Final resolution (WF03-gh375-20260804): Migration 1134_iss0112_add_secret_ref_to_tenant_schemas.sql adds webhook_subscriptions.secret_ref and secret_key_id columns to all SCHEMA-mode tenant schemas. Root cause: GBL-128_exp501_secrets.sql added these columns to public.webhook_subscriptions, but that table was dropped by GBL-073 (multi-tenant restructure). GBL-133 reconciliation only attempted to add columns to public schema, missing the per-tenant schemas where webhook_subscriptions actually lives in SCHEMA mode. Migration 1134 iterates all tenant_* schemas and adds the columns idempotently. Verification: test report shows no missing secret_ref column errors in integration run; EXT-02 webhook tests no longer fail on column-not-found. Previous resolution (GBL-105) addressed ledger drift and public schema reconciliation; 1134 completes the per-tenant schema coverage.
prevention: Migration applier guard `reapply_on_drift` (force_reconcile in Migrations.runForSchema) + per-test isolation helpers in tests/integration/helpers.zig (cleanupTestTenant(), tenant_type='test' default) + verify_schema_baseline.py (4-invariant schema/tenant consistency checker with --auto-fix) — see src/design/fix-iss0112.md for full design.
